recommendation: Address transportation barriers within comprehensive social needs assessment
implementation_steps: Address transportation barriers within broader social needs assessment
Connect patients to financial assistance programs for transportation
Advocate for policy changes to improve transportation access
Coordinate with community organizations to develop transportation solutions
Ensure transportation plans account for patient's full range of social needs
evidence_summary: Social worker-led interventions addressing transportation barriers have demonstrated improvements in healthcare access and outcomes when integrated within comprehensive social needs assessment and advocacy.
